name: Grilled Chicken Breast Skewers with Sweet Glaze
whyItWorks: Tender chunks of boneless chicken breast grilled on bamboo skewers with a gentle sweet soy reduction. Lean protein without frying batter or roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request skewers without spicy aioli drizzle or sesame seeds. Accompany with steamed rice or a plain soft roll.
